name: Medina del Campo (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Medina del Campo (thirteen roundels on blue within a border inscribed NI EL PAPA BENEFICIO NI EL REY OFICIO).
history: Municipal flag of Medina del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
